desc: Write full solution: fast I/O parsing of N, Q, array A, and queries.
Implement max-Fenwick: update(pos, val) propagates max upward; query(pos) returns max over [1..pos].
Sort queries by R (keep original indices); sweep pointer i=1..N computing len = 1 + bit.query(comp[A_i]-1), then bit.update(comp[A_i], len).
Answer each query after advancing sweep to R: p = bisect_right(coords, X); ans = bit.query(p); store at original index.
Output answers in original order, one per line; sanity-check logic against samples (sample 1 → 2,1,2; sample 2 → 4,1,1,2,1,5,3,4).
